title: [P0] Implement native Yggdrasil AddrForKey in Rust
description:
Spec updated in 06-security.md §8.7 to use native Yggdrasil algorithm.

## Algorithm (from yggdrasil-go)
```
inverted = NOT(pubkey)
ones = count_leading_ones(inverted)
skip terminating 0-bit
remaining = next 112 bits
addr = [0x02] || [ones] || remaining[0:14]
IID = addr[8:16]
```

## Files to update
- `rust/lichen-core/src/addr.rs`: `iid_from_pubkey_bytes()`, `ygg_addr_from_pubkey()`
- `rust/lichen-link/src/identity.rs`: Any re-exports or wrappers

## Test vector (upstream)
pubkey: bdbacfd82240de3dcd123924cbb55256fb8dab08aa98e305528ab84f419e6efb
addr:   0200848a604fbb7e438465db8db66895
IID:    438465db8db66895

## Key change
- Remove SHA-512 dependency for address derivation
- IID is lower 8 bytes of Yggdrasil address (pure bit manipulation)
- Current code claims 'exact Yggdrasil AddrForKey' but uses simplified hash-based algo
